translations.en.sahih: Woe to every scorner and mocker
translations.en.yusufali: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaanlah bagi setiap pengumpat lagi pencela,

translations.en.sahih: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
translations.en.pickthall: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
translations.en.yusufali: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,

translations.en.sahih: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
translations.en.pickthall: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
translations.en.yusufali: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
translations.id.indonesian: dia mengira bahwa hartanya itu dapat mengkekalkannya,

transliteration: Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah

translations.en.sahih: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
translations.en.yusufali: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
translations.id.indonesian: sekali-kali tidak! Sesungguhnya dia benar-benar akan dilemparkan ke dalam Huthamah.

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tahukah kamu apa Huthamah itu?

translations.en.sahih: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
translations.en.pickthall: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
translations.en.yusufali: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),

translations.en.sahih: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
translations.en.pickthall: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
translations.en.yusufali: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it is closed in on them
translations.en.yusufali: It shall be made into a vault over them,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya api itu ditutup rapat atas mereka,
(sedang mereka itu) diikat pada tiang-tiang yang panjang.
